privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.sec1Text1: Welcome to Empire of Forex ("we," "us," "our," or the "Company"). We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring you have a positive experience on our website and trading platform.
privacyPolicy.sec1Text2: Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, please do not use our service.
privacyPolicy.sec2Item1: Account Registration: Name, email address, phone number, and password.
privacyPolicy.sec2Item2: Financial Information: Payment card information, investment amounts, and transaction history.
privacyPolicy.sec2Item3: Identity Verification: Government-issued ID, proof of address, and verification documents.
privacyPolicy.sec2Item4: Device Information: Operating system, browser type, and IP address.
privacyPolicy.sec2Item5: Usage Data: Pages visited, interaction patterns, and performance metrics.
privacyPolicy.sec3Desc: We use the collected information for:
privacyPolicy.sec3Item1: Providing and maintaining our trading platform and services.
privacyPolicy.sec3Item2: Processing deposits, payouts, and financial transactions.
privacyPolicy.sec3Item3: Sending real-time trading signals and security alerts.
privacyPolicy.sec3Item4: Complying with regulatory anti-money laundering (AML) and KYC requirements.
privacyPolicy.sec4Desc: We do not sell your personal information. We only share data with regulated payment processors, cloud infrastructure partners, and legal authorities when required by law.
privacyPolicy.sec5Desc: We implement 256-bit SSL/TLS encryption, secure server architecture, and strict access controls to safeguard your personal data.
privacyPolicy.sec6Desc: You have the right to access, rectify, or request deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting our support team at support@empireofforex.com.
privacyPolicy.sec7Desc: We use essential cookies to maintain your authenticated session and remember your language and display preferences.
privacyPolicy.sec8Desc: For questions regarding this policy, contact our Data Protection Officer at support@empireofforex.com.

termsOfService.sec2Desc: You must be at least 18 years of age and legally permitted to trade financial instruments in your country of residence.
termsOfService.sec3Desc: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account.
termsOfService.sec4Warning: Trading foreign exchange and financial contracts carries substantial risk of loss. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
termsOfService.sec4Desc: Signals, market analysis, and educational materials provided by Empire of Forex are for informational purposes and should not be construed as individualized investment advice.
termsOfService.sec5Desc: Deposits and withdrawal requests are processed according to our standard settlement timelines. Users must verify their identity before withdrawing funds.
termsOfService.sec6Desc: Users may not engage in market manipulation, unauthorized automated scraping, system exploitation, or abusive conduct.
termsOfService.sec7Desc: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate our security policies or legal requirements.
termsOfService.sec8Desc: Empire of Forex shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or trading losses incurred while using our platform.
termsOfService.sec9Desc: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with international commercial law standards.
termsOfService.sec10Desc: For legal inquiries, please contact legal@empireofforex.com.
